senses.gloss:
पुट् I. €6 P. (पुटति)
—1 To embrace, clasp.
—2 To intertwine. ━II. €10 U. (पुटयति-ते)
—1 To be in contact with.
—2 To bind together, fasten.
—3 (पोटयति-ते)
——(a) To grind, reduce to powder.
——(b) To speak.
——(c) To shine. ━III. €1 P. (पोटति)
—1 To grind.
—2 To rub.

पुट्ट् €10 U. (पुट्टयति-ते)
—1 To become small, decrease, diminish.
—2 To be low or shallow.
—3 To disregard, disrespect.

पुटः, -टम्
 [पुट्-क]
—1 A fold.
—2 A hollow space, cavity, concavity; भिन्नपल्लवपुटो वनानिलः R. 9. 68, 11. 23, 17. 12;
 M. 3. 9; अञ्जलिपुट, नासापुट, कर्णपुट &c.
—3 A cup made of a leaf folded or doubled; a vessel of leaves; दुग्ध्वा
 पयः पत्रपुटे मदीयम् R. 2. 65; Ms. 6. 28.
—6 Any shallow receptacle.
—5 The pod or capsule which envelops young shoots.
—6 A sheath, cover, covering
—7 An eye-lid (पुटी also in all these senses).
—8 A horseʼs hoof.
—9 A cloth worn to cover the privities.

पुटः, -टम् + .{@-टः@}
—1 A casket.
—2 The contracting of anything.
—3 A folding of anything so as to form a cup.

पुटः, -टम्
 [पुट्-क]
—1 A fold.
—2 A hollow space, cavity, concavity; भिन्नपल्लवपुटो वनानिलः R. 9. 68, 11. 23, 17. 12;
 M. 3. 9; अञ्जलिपुट, नासापुट, कर्णपुट &c.
—3 A cup made of a leaf folded or doubled; a vessel of leaves; दुग्ध्वा
 पयः पत्रपुटे मदीयम् R. 2. 65; Ms. 6. 28.
—6 Any shallow receptacle.
—5 The pod or capsule which envelops young shoots.
—6 A sheath, cover, covering
—7 An eye-lid (पुटी also in all these senses).
—8 A horseʼs hoof.
—9 A cloth worn to cover the privities.

पुटः, -टम् + .{@-टम्@}
—1 A nutmeg.
—2 Two vessels joined together for medical purposes.
.━{@Comp.@}: पुटाञ्जलिः, पुटोटजम्, पुटोदकः, पुटग्रीवः, पुटधेनुः, पुटपाकः, पुटभेदः, पुटभेदनम्

पुटः + -अञ्जलिः the two hollowed hands put together; श्रीकृष्णपुरतः
 स्थित्वा तुष्टाव तं पुटाञ्जलिः Brav. P. 3. 9, 23.
पुटः + -उटजम् a white umbrella.
पुटः + -उदकः a cocoa-nut.

पुटः + -ग्रीवः
—1 a pot, jar, pitcher.
—2 a copper-vessel.
पुटः + -धेनुः a not yet full-grown cow with a calf.

पुटः + -पाकः
—1 a particular method of preparing drugs, in which the various ingredients
 are wrapped up in leaves, and being covered with clay are roasted in the
 fire; अनिर्भिन्नो गभीरत्वादन्तर्गूढघनव्यथः । पुटपाकप्रतीकाशो रामस्य
 करुणो रसः U. 3. 1.
—2 digesting.
—3 subliming.

पुटः + -भेदः
—1 a town, city.
—2 a kind of musical instrument (आतोद्य).
—3 ‘parting of the eyelids’, opening; पुटभेदो ललाटस्थनीललोहितचक्षुषः U. 6. 3.
—4 a whirlpool or eddy.

पुटः + -भेदनम् a town, city; स हस्तिनपुरे रम्ये कुरूणां पुटभेदने
 (वसन्) Mb. 1. 100. 12; पुटभेदनं दनुसुतारिरैक्षत Śi. 13. 26.

—1 A fold; रुद्रो येन कपालपाणिपुटके भिक्षाटनं कारितः Bh. 1. 95.
—2 Any shallow cup or cavity.
—3 A vessel made of a leaf.
—4 A lotus.
—5 Nutmeg.

—1 A lotus.
—2 A group of lotuses.
पुटनम् Enveloping, wrapping.
पुटिका Cardamoms.

पुटित a.
—1 Rubbed, ground.
—2 Contracted.
—3 Stitched, sewn.
—4 Split.
पुटित + .{@-तम्@} The hollow of the hands.
पुटी A small piece of cloth worn over the privities; (for other senses see पुट).
पुटीकृ To make into a funnel-shaped vessel; B. R.
